t: $(thing)Glycerol/$ is a by-product of producing $(l:renewables/biodiesel)Biodiesel/$, but it turns out to be a rather useful substance in its own right. Its uses are detailed in the following pages.
$(thing)甘油/$是生产$(l:renewables/biodiesel)生物柴油/$时的副产物，但事实证明它本身也是一种相当有用的物质。它的用途会在接下来的页面中详细说明。

$(thing)Bandages/$ can be used to quickly heal 3 hearts of health. Quickly is not instantaneous, though; you will need to right-click and hold for 2 seconds to apply a bandage, and there is an 8-second cooldown between uses.
$(thing)绷带/$可用于快速恢复 3 颗红心的生命值。不过，“快速”并不等于瞬间生效；你需要按住右击 2 秒来使用绷带，并且每次使用之间有 8 秒冷却时间。
Double the output of using $(thing)Sugar/$, what's not to like? This will save on your precious $(l:components/lubricant)Lubricant/$.
使用$(thing)砂糖/$时产量翻倍，这还有什么不好的呢？这样还能节省你珍贵的$(l:components/lubricant)润滑油/$。
$(thing)Glycerol/$ also makes a decent fuel item, equivalent to 4 $(thing)Planks/$ or half a lump of $(thing)Coal/$.
$(thing)甘油/$也是一种不错的燃料，相当于 4 个$(thing)木板/$或半块$(thing)煤炭/$。
